result.title: Individualist — a working hypothesis
result.body: Partial resonance can be useful without being conclusive. Separate the parts that sound familiar from the parts that do not, then look for the underlying motive in more than one situation before drawing a working conclusion. This prompt specifically invites you to notice the Type 4 theme of work only variation 1 before treating any single reaction as proof.
result.cta: Keep only what is useful for reflection.
